status: Three concept directions for discussion; engine, final camera scale, and production assets are not selected.

directions.name: Чернила и пепел
directions.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one polished game visual-development keyframe for an original browser action RPG about an unarmed martial-arts monk. Landscape 16:9. Actual playable gameplay camera, elevated three-quarter orthographic isometric view of an entire small ancient temple courtyard arena, not a promotional character closeup. The main monk occupies about 9 percent of frame height at the center. He is an adult lean athletic fighter with shaved head, bone-white sleeveless wrapped tunic, long muted vermilion waist sash, dark loose trousers, ochre prayer beads and bronze wrapped gauntlets. Show him completing a fast diagonal dash into a forceful palm strike, a short warm amber afterimage following the movement. Five visually distinct dark temple guardians with spears, masks and shields surround him at readable distances; one recoils from the hit. All characters fully visible, readable uncluttered combat floor. Original ancient monastery setting: fractured flagstones, one circular carved mandala on the floor, low relief walls, broken bronze bell, sparse braziers and angular pillars at perimeter. Palette: ink-black plum shadows, desaturated stone, bone white hero, focused saffron and vermilion highlights. Distinct hand-painted 2D illustrated aesthetics inspired by Hades: confident angular ink outlines, graphic cel-shaded masses, exquisite painterly texture in the environment, punchy silhouette design and elegant diagonal composition. Use mythic scale in the architecture as in Titan Quest, clear chunky equipment as in Torchlight, fluid martial arts like the monk in Diablo 3, but create original characters and symbols. Direction A: inky, ritualistic, warm, emphatically drawn and graphic. Light the hero more strongly than the surroundings. Nothing photorealistic, no generic Unreal engine render, no neon cyberpunk, no text, no logo, no HUD, no health bars, no border, no layout labels, no watermark. This is a game camera mood concept, not an implementation screenshot.

directions.name: Ночной ритуал
directions.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One original browser action RPG gameplay art keyframe, 16:9 landscape. Direction B is an emphatically TOP-DOWN TWO-DIMENSIONAL PIXEL ART treatment, inspired by the strong floor plans, graphic violence of motion, saturated colored light and low-resolution pixel aesthetics of Hotline Miami, translated into an ancient mystical temple with an unarmed monk. Exact 90 DEGREE OVERHEAD ORTHOGRAPHIC CAMERA looking STRAIGHT DOWN. No isometric view, no horizon, no cinematic perspective, no visible vertical front facades. Arrange a compact square arena inside a rectilinear ancient temple courtyard; perimeter walls are cutaway floor-plan outlines. A circular stone mandala in the center. Floor fills the frame. Crisp intentionally chunky visible pixels, sharp edges, controlled limited palette, hand-placed clusters and pixel dithering, not blurry modern illustration. Bone-white marble flagstones divided into flat graphic fields; charcoal nearly black corners; aggressive magenta-red ritual lamps from one side, cold cyan turquoise braziers from the other, small hot yellow accents. The center of floor is bright enough to read every fighter. One small adult bald martial-arts monk at center, bone-white sleeveless outfit, dark trousers, long crimson sash and bronze fist wraps, completing a dash and palm strike; as seen from overhead read his head, shoulders, fists, stance and trailing sash. The monk is 7 percent of total image height. Five dark hooded spear-and-shield temple guardians surround him at distinct positions, clean silhouettes, generous spaces. Three sharply spaced cyan dash afterimages and a short coral impact slash show the direction of attack. Broken stone columns read as circles from above; bronze bell, low stair treads at top, no rooftop occlusion. Keep overall graphics spare, rhythmic and immediate, with strong rectangular environmental composition, a real playable combat arena. Original characters and temple symbols. No firearms, no modern city, no cars, no UI, no text, no logo, no health bars, no borders or watermark, no photorealism.

directions.name: Камень и жар
directions.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one high-end original browser action RPG gameplay visual development concept, landscape 16:9. Direction C: sculptural stylized 2.5D / 3D volumes seen by a FIXED elevated orthographic three-quarter game camera; hand-painted surfaces and controlled two-tone cel shading, graphic silhouette readability. This should look tangibly dimensional with carved raised edges and satisfying bulky architecture, but painted like illustration, not realistic. Broad sun-warmed ancient sandstone monastery courtyard with an intricately carved circular mandala on a pale stone floor, huge weathered ivory columns, oxidized turquoise bronze door and broken temple bell at perimeter, ochre staircases and sparse dry grasses. Mythic Mediterranean antiquity mood and sense of discovery inspired by Titan Quest; charming strong stylized forms and sculpted equipment shapes inspired by Torchlight, with Hades-like bold painterly lighting. Clear actual gameplay framing of a whole compact combat arena, the whole floor visible, not a cinematic hero poster. At center one adult shaved-head athletic unarmed monk in a bone-white sleeveless wrapped tunic, dark wide trousers, a long vermilion sash and heavy bronze gauntlets, about 10 percent of frame height. He performs a low powerful palm strike just out of a dash, with warm golden impact arc, short dust trail and tiny loose stone chips. Five distinct dark ochre masked stone-and-bronze temple guardians with spears and shields, full bodies visible and spaced clearly; one recoils. Keep central combat area uncluttered. Directional honey-colored late afternoon light casts crisp long cool desaturated blue-purple shadows; mostly pale sunbleached limestone and burnt saffron with small turquoise accents, luminous amber attack, restrained red sash. Rich chunky geometry with brush-painted texture details, angular shapes softened by wear, illustrated and inviting rather than grimdark. Original character design, no copied heroes. No UI, text, logo, health bars, border or watermark; no photorealism, no generic glossy Unreal look, no pixel art, no overhead 90 degree view.
